name: Codman Shoulder Pendulum

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Rotator Cuff and Shoulder Conditioning Program

steps: Stand beside a sturdy table or bench and bend forward at your hips roughly 75 to 90 degrees.
Place your unaffected hand and forearm firmly on the table for full torso support.
Allow your affected arm to hang completely limp and relaxed straight down toward the floor.
Gently shift your body weight and sway your hips from side to side, forward and backward, and in small circles.
Allow the passive momentum generated by your torso rocking to swing your relaxed arm in gentle circles without engaging your shoulder muscles.
Perform clockwise circles, counter-clockwise circles, and gentle pendulum swings for the prescribed duration.
coaching_cues: The swinging arm must remain completely passive and limp; imagine it is an empty coat sleeve.
Do not actively contract your shoulder or arm muscles; let gravity and torso rocking do all the work.
Keep your neck relaxed and gaze down at the floor.
